entries.title: Family Movie Night at the Library
entries.description: If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

entries.title: Photography Meetup
entries.description: Each session will feature discussions on techniques, tips for improving your craft, and other aspects of photography.nbsp;Ideas for 5-10 min topics, photo stories, ornbsp;presentations can be emailed to matthewtwhuang@gmail.com.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 每次聚会都会讨论摄影技巧、提高拍摄水平的方法与其他摄影话题。

entries.title: Mind Floating: An Art Exhibit
entries.description: Looking back, I can see changes in the way I draw and the things I notice, alongside familiar themes I continue to return to.Photos Courtesy of the Artist
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 回顾过去，我能看到自己的绘画方式和关注的事物发生了变化，同时也能发现一些始终反复出现的熟悉主题。

entries.title: LEGO Club
entries.description: nbsp;Students in Kindergarten to 8th grade are welcome to play and create with LEGOs on the first Tuesday of each month.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欢迎幼儿园至 8 年级学生在每月第一个星期二使用 LEGO 积木玩耍和创作。

entries.title: Reading Buddies [Compañeros de Lectura]
entries.description: Each 15-minute session is with a specially trained therapy dog and their volunteer.nbsp;Reading Buddies in the Gilroy Library will take place the 1st Tuesdaynbsp;of each month starting in September.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 与一位毛茸茸的朋友一对一大声朗读，练习阅读技巧。

entries.title: Knit & Crochet Circle @ Saratoga Library
entries.description: Bring your own projects and yarn, ask questions, receive help, give help,nbsp;share ideas, and meet new people!

entries.title: Poponta Japanese Storytime
entries.description: This Japanese storytelling session will include traditional kamishibai (paper theater), puppets and books!

entries.title: Year of Letters: Celebrate Connection Through Greeting Cards
entries.description: Join us at the library for Year of Letters, a heartwarming program where people come together to create and send greeting cards!

entries.title: Line Dancing with Sandy and Kent
entries.description: If you register, you will get an email reminder for the program including a link to the class playlist to practice.\n
entries.priorTitleZh: Sandy 和 Kent 的排舞课
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 报名后会收到课程提醒邮件及练习用的歌曲播放列表链接。

entries.title: Little Explorers: Wonderful Winter!
entries.description: nbsp;We may not have snow, but we can still play in a wintery way, with a variety of snowy-themed crafts and play activities.Little Explorers is a monthly creativity-based program for families with toddlers and preschoolers.nbsp;nbsp;nbsp;Join us on the first Friday of the month to explore new ways to play and learn!
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 这里也许没有雪，但仍可通过多种冰雪主题手工和游戏，体验冬日乐趣。

entries.title: LOCATION CHANGE: Mindfulness Meditation
entries.description: It is open to all levels of experience and no registration is required.\nParticipants are encouraged to bring their own yoga mats and/or meditation cushions.nbsp;Chairs are availablenbsp;for those who do not bring them.\nPhuong is a Buddhist nun experienced in leading mindfulness meditation.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 每次包括 30 分钟静坐冥想、15 分钟放松练习，以及 15 分钟分享与问答。欢迎所有水平的参与者，无需报名。

entries.title: Family BINGO
entries.description: nbsp;We will be running multiple rounds, so you can drop in and play anytime.

entries.title: Holiday Jazz Music
entries.description: Join us for MAK Band Jazz, a special sing-along performance of holiday favorites.\nThis band is an ensemble featuring guitar, ukulele, trumpet, tenor saxophone, alto saxophone, clarinet, trombone, bass, drums, harmonica and percussion, along with special guest jazz musicians.They will perform popular holiday music, including songs such as "Jingle Bells," "Frosty the Snowman," "Let It Snow," “Rockin’ Around the Christmas Tree,” and others.\nThis is a family program.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 演出将呈现多首热门节日歌曲，包括《Jingle Bells》《Frosty the Snowman》《Let It Snow》《Rockin’ Around the Christmas Tree》等。

entries.title: Baby Sign and Sing
entries.description: Join us for Sign and Sing for Babies in our first floor program room!
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 成年照护者将学习用于与婴儿沟通的基础手语。

entries.title: Domingos de Matiné con merienda
entries.description: After the movie, there will be a brief discussion about the movie’s history, its making and themes.\nThere will be snacks to enjoy with the movie!
entries.priorTitleZh: 周日下午电影与点心（Domingos de Matiné con merienda）
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 电影结束后，将简短讨论影片的历史、制作过程和主题。

entries.title: LEGO Club for Grades K-8
entries.description: Children will use their creativity and engineering skills to free build anything they can imagine.\nThis is a drop-in program.
entries.priorTitleZh: K–8 年级 LEGO 乐高俱乐部
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 孩子们将发挥创造力和工程技能，自由搭建自己想象中的各种作品。

entries.title: Growing Readers: Help Your Aspiring Writer
entries.description: A freenbsp;workshop for parents and caregivers presented by Santa Clara County Office of Education and The Reading Program of Santa Clara County Library District.nbsp;\nHelp your child gain confidence as a writer.
entries.priorTitleZh: 培养阅读者：帮助有写作兴趣的孩子
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 面向父母和照护者的免费工作坊，由 Santa Clara County Office of Education 与 Santa Clara County Library District 的 The Reading Program 联合举办。

entries.title: No-Sew Fabric Bird Ornament Craft
entries.description: Come make your own charming, one-of-a-kind fabric bird ornament!

entries.title: Poetry in the Dark
entries.description: This December, join us for a dimly lit evening of shared poetry at the Cupertino Library.nbsp;Voices of all ages, cultures, and languages come together to share the power of the spoken and written word.nbsp;Each participant may read their poem(s) aloud to their group.nbsp;Hosted by Thomas Célérier - Cupertino Poet LaureateAll are welcome.No prior experience necessary.

entries.title: Community Threads: Holiday Placemat
entries.description: In this workshop folks willnbsp;learn how to make a festive holiday placemat to decorate your home for the holidays.nbsp;Workshop suitable for the advanced beginner, intermediate, or advanced sewist.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 学习制作节日主题餐垫，为家里增添节日装饰。

entries.title: A Look into the Night Sky with Astro Everywhere
entries.description: \nWe’ll gather in the Treetop Room for a live astronomy show featuring planetarium software to explore the night sky as seen from Palo Alto.
entries.priorTitleZh: 与 Astro Everywhere 一起仰望夜空
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 大家将在 Treetop Room 参加现场天文演示，使用天文馆软件探索从 Palo Alto 看到的夜空。

entries.title: Rinconada Library's Holiday Movie Night: Polar Express
entries.description: Join us at Rinconada Library for a holiday movie night featuring The Polar Express!
